text:
Three facts about lighthouses:
1. Lighthouses are typically located on high ground or rocky outcrops to maximize the visibility of their light over long distances.
2. The intensity of a lighthouse beam is measured in candela, and modern lighthouses often use LED or rotating Fresnel lenses to project light up to 20-30 nautical miles.
3. Many historic lighthouses are now automated and serve as museums or tourist attractions, having been decommissioned from active maritime navigation duties.

LORERE-MIHEDE
